status: No remaining concrete blocker found in the reviewed integration
scope: Static source, donor API, binary manifest, compiled JVM signatures and isolated protocol/native fixtures; no physical gameplay or production registry validation
confirmed: All 20 required Bridge hooks have the exact public static JVM descriptors in the compiled Java3 classes; Java4 adds the descriptor-size writer guard without changing their contract
Seven donor smali inputs are pinned and preserved; the recipe modifies a separate partition
StationN64Activity is private in the main process; original GameActivity and CoreService remain in :n64core with original attributes
Manifest patch is reversible to the exact original bytes and preserves existing Activity declarations
830 bundled mupen64plus_data entries exist in R124; bootstrap copies missing assets without overwriting existing files
Actual RomHeader(byte[]) exposes crc, name and isValid and normalizes byte order in place; actual GameActivity entry is start()
Bridge validates the private descriptor before CoreInterface construction and selects the separate core variant only for that verified Station session
Service and Activity share the existing n64core process; marker propagation includes the private notification PendingIntent
HTTP owner/result anchoring retains room, generation, attempt and request binding; launch completion does not imply human leave
GamePrefs and working directories are isolated by verified object identity; no global offline preference or AppData replacement
Host starts the native emulator after all real TCP registrations, before waiting for native main_run pause acknowledgment; preparation DATA is pumped while paused, avoiding a circular READY wait
Only a real native pause acknowledgment can qualify for relay READY; initialization alone cannot fake readiness
Autosave suppression preserves the explicit shutdown chain; automatic shutdown and forceExit are gated before timers or process termination
Native STOP, reset and advance-frame guards affect only the Station variant; the offline donor remains unchanged
The pre-plugin registration blocker is fixed in full-5: signed slot selects MEMORY2/raw0 without reading uninitialized Controls; EOF polling no longer spins on recv returning zero
Descriptor serialization now rejects files exceeding the same 32768-byte bound enforced by the reader
limits: These checks do not prove Android frame pacing, game compatibility, Bluetooth response or live multiplayer stability
The new engine identity and exact hashes still require the server contract to admit them before a real session
Real two-, three- and four-device gameplay remains a separate validation step
